about: ZIP-level California home-insurance market data baked by scripts/build-insurability-data.py. z[zip]: nr = share of policies not renewed in the latest year, np = share of CA ZIPs (>=500 policies) with a lower nr, n0/n1 = new policies written in the first/latest year, v/f = dwelling units insured by the voluntary market / FAIR Plan, fs = f/(v+f), p = FAIR Plan residential policies in force by fiscal year (newest first), fe = p[0]/(v+f) (rough current FAIR share), fp = share of CA ZIPs with a lower fe, um = 1 if on the CDI undermarketed list.

fairPIF.note: FAIR Plan fiscal years end Sept 30
